notes.title: Full Release Coming Soon & an Update for the Demo Build
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we’ve entered the final phase of development for the game. We’re now polishing the last few details and handling translations. If all goes well, we aim to release the full version of the game, complete with all its features, in the coming weeks.

In the meantime, we’ve addressed several bugs and made improvements based on feedback from our playtesters, including:


Changed Signs to point directions better
Reworded some tutorial instructions to be clearer
Ores, Ingots and Workpieces will now glow
Steps will not appear in Progress Guide if corresponding stations are not unlocked
Reputation loss is no longer a thing for the Demo
Customers will now stand closer to the door
Customers will no longer stuck each other
Prevented getting orders that require locked stations
Blade cooldown will now appear in the progress guide
Weather audio is now adjustable in the settings
Pressing Escape will now exit you out of all menus
Tutorial now has a completed popup
Vise steps will now be visible on the progress guide
Resolution now appears correctly in the settings
Polished overall sound ambiance and SFXs
Added an additional state for blades (“Cooled Down”)
Fixed Game Saving issues
Fixed Spelling and Wording issues
Reworked Vise Minigame to wait for user input before starting
Added an ideal temperature range that narrows as user forges
Adjusted Bucket use on stations
Added Oil Barrel to Tutorial
Fixed Incorrect Sword positioning on anvil
Added animals to the forest


We’d like to thank you for your patience, dedication, and reports. Your support keeps us motivated to deliver the best possible experience for the community.

We hope to become the best BlackSmith game on Steam yet!
